brief.ask: Create a brand identity for Kilnroom, the online shop in this folder.
brief.owner: Owner preferences: handmade and warm but not rustic or folksy; no pottery wheels, no vase or mug silhouettes, no flames. It must work on a shipping label, a tissue-paper sticker and Instagram. Web and social only; customers in Turkey and Europe.

claim.notes: Üç yönden ikisi eskiz incelemesinde iki turda elendi, stack iki yeniden çalışma turundan sonra da kapıyı geçemedi (en iyi ortalama 6,23, memorability/distinctiveness eşik altı), bu yüzden hiçbir konsept sonuçlandırılmadı.

concepts.title: Glaze Pool
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s6 paint drop or speech bubble with a tail; s7 plug or tangled noodle on a disc; s8 magnifier or search icon; s9 ball-and-bulb, a metaball or male symbol. All four are generic blobs or UI icons. s8 is the most considered but is a magnifying glass. s9 is the cleanest but is a stock metaball, and none of them says kiln, firing or drop. Different move: leave the blob; find a form for the moment of glaze meeting fired clay that has a distinctive silhouette and one meaningful edge, not a drip. Make sure it reads on a one-colour thermal label.

concepts.title: Kiln Shelves
readsAs: a stack of H/I-beam slabs (工 or Ξ-like glyph)
a bookshelf or shelving unit with one drawer pulled out
a stylised letter E or Hebrew-like character
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s2 a K with a loose slash (stock letter); s3 pixel-tile K or QR fragment; s4 striped K with one amber shelf pulled out; s5 K plus play button (cliche). Strike s5 (play triangle) and s3 (pixel/QR). s2 is a plain K. Keep s4: kiln shelves as stripes and one slid shelf is the idea, and the offset survives in one colour. Fix: sliced-letter is a known genre, so make the slid shelf do the work (bigger offset, uneven slice heights), keep 16px counters open, and verify the one-colour label version without amber. Risk is moderate; if it comes out as a generic striped K, reject.

concepts.title: Threshold
concepts.sketchNotes: Reads as: s6 sliced donut or broken arch, two fragments; s7 sliced coin or ball; s8 folding fan or open scissors; s5 K-flag. s6 is the only one with a kiln-vault idea, but the idea is not legible: at 16 px it is two specks, and the split arch resembles a pie-chart or rainbow fragment. s7 and s8 are stock shapes with no kiln link. Different move: stop splitting solids. Build one confident, ownable gesture from the kiln-opening moment (the glowing gap as a single negative-space form inside a distinctive silhouette that is not a K or an arch), and test it as a one-colour sticker first.
